					<p>Good news for those who want tostudy in Singapore! The Singapore International Pre-Graduate Award (SIPGA 2026) is accepting applications. This international scholarship is an excellent opportunity for students who are pursuing their bachelor’s or master’s degrees. The SIPGA 2026 is a short-term <a href="https://www.opportunitiescircle.com/blog/top-paid-fully-funded-research-programs/"><strong>research program</strong></a> that offers top international students a unique opportunity to experience a dynamic scientific atmosphere. Students will work on their research projects for two to six months and collaborate with globally acclaimed researchers at A*STAR’s Research Entities. The Singapore International Award offers the chance to study in Singapore and pursue research abroad. The SIPGA scholarship 2026 is mainly for students in the field of science and technology (STEM). This includes Computing and Information Science, Biomedical Science, Physical Science, or Engineering related disciplines. If you are interested in a fully funded international PhD scholarship, apply for the <strong><a href="https://www.opportunitiescircle.com/singapore-international-graduate-award/">Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA 2026)</a>. </strong></p>
<p>Similarly, the Singapore International Pre Graduate Award 2026 is a prestigious research <a href="https://www.opportunitiescircle.com/daad-scholarship-in-germany/"><strong>international scholarship </strong></a>in Singapore that will help undergraduate and master’s students to polish their research skills. With the SIPGA award, students will pursue their research project and work with researchers at A*STAR Research Institutes. The Singapore international scholarship offers students a monthly stipend of $2,000. Hence reducing the financial burden on students who could not study in Singapore before. Moreover, the A*STAR Singapore International Pre-Graduate Award (SIPGA) is a fantastic opportunity for outstanding students who are looking for an international award in Singapore. This <a href="https://www.opportunitiescircle.com/blog/undergraduate-scholarships-in-uk-for-international-students/"><strong>undergraduate scholarship</strong></a> program for international students from all around the world allows aspiring scientists and engineers to take their first steps towards a rewarding research career. Therefore, do not miss out on this opportunity to get a scholarship in Singapore 2025.</p>
<p>The SIPGA scholarship 2026 provides awardees a chance to experience Singapore’s research and academic community, which will open the door to success. Students from around the world with an interest in research are highly encouraged to apply for the Singapore Pre-Graduate Award (SIPGA 2026). With the SIPGA Singapore program, students will become a SIPGA awardee and have the opportunity to pursue a SIPGA project in 2025. Students will also have access to A*STAR Research labs/Entities, hence there are various benefits of the SIPGA Pre Graduate Award. So, if you want to study in Singapore, then you must apply for the Singapore Pre Graduate Award 2026.</p>
<p> </p>
<h2><strong>Research Areas for SIPGA 2026:</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Biomedical Sciences (BMS)</li>
<li>Computing and Information Sciences (CIT)</li>
<li>Physical Sciences (PS)</li>
<li>Engineering and Technology (E&T)</li>
</ul>

									<h2> <strong> Eligibility Criteria : </strong> </h2><p>Do you want to be a SIPGA Awardee? If yes, do not forget to go through the eligibility criteria and requirements for Singapore International Pre-Graduate Award (SIPGA 2026). Opportunities Circle has compiled the criteria for SIPGA below.</p>
<h3>Eligibility Criteria for Singapore International Pre Graduate Award 2026:</h3>
<ul>
<li>The SIPGA scholarship 2026 a*star is open to both bachelor’s and master’s students.</li>
<li>It is available to international 3rd and 4th year undergraduate and master’s students, currently studying a STEM program at universities outside Singapore.</li>
<li>For the Singapore scholarship, applicants must have attained, or be on track to achieve, at least a Second-Class (Upper) Honors or its equivalent in their bachelor’s degree.</li>
<li>Moreover, all participants must maintain their enrollment status at their home university throughout the duration of the attachment at A*STAR.</li>
<li>Proficiency in both written and spoken English is essential for effective communication during the SIPGA program.</li>
<li>Similarly, applicants should demonstrate a strong interest in pursuing a career in research to be eligible for the Singapore International Pre Graduate Award.</li>
<li>A*STAR may also add additional selection criteria based on prevailing scholarship policies.</li>
</ul>

									<h2><strong> Benefits : </strong> </h2><p>If you meet the eligibility criteria above, you must apply for the International Singapore Pre Graduate Award 2026. The SIPGA Award offers numerous benefits to all awardees, so make sure to read the benefits below.</p>

<ul>
<li>The SIPGA program has a monthly stipend of $2,000. Hence, reducing the cost of studying in Singapore.</li>
<li>Participants will gain valuable research experience by working with world-renowned researchers at A*STAR Research Entities.</li>
<li>The Singapore International Pre-Graduate Award offers international students the opportunity to experience Singapore’s vibrant scientific environment.</li>
<li>Moreover, engagement in research projects under the guidance of experienced mentors and researchers allows students to develop professionally.</li>
<li>SIPGA encourages international collaboration and cultural exchange. Thus, enabling students to work alongside peers from diverse backgrounds and perspectives and making the most out of this STEM scholarship.</li>
<li>Successful completion of the SIPGA program may open doors to future research collaborations or graduate study options in Singapore.</li>
</ul>

									<h2><strong> Application Process: </strong></h2><ul>
<li>Want to know how to apply for the Singapore International Pre Graduate Award 2026?</li>
<li>To apply for the SIPGA program, visit the official application portal or click the ‘apply now’ button below. This will redirect you to the official application portal.</li>
<li>However, before you apply, ensure you meet the eligibility criteria and requirements of this SIPGA scholarship in Singapore.</li>
<li>Applicants should download the SIPGA Projects list to select the projects they wish to apply for.</li>
<li>You may select and apply for up to 3 projects.</li>
<li>Similarly, all applicants must fill and submit the online application form.</li>
<li>As part of the application for Singapore International Pre Graduate Award 2026,<strong> </strong>submit all the necessary documents as mentioned above.</li>
<li>Shortlisted students will then be invited for an online interview by an A*STAR researcher.</li>
<li>Only selected students will be contacted. Successful students will receive notification within two months from the date of the interview.</li>
<li>Make sure to apply before the SIPGA Scholarship deadline for attachments starting in January-April 2026.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Application Deadline for the Singapore International Pre Graduate Award (SIPGA):</h3>
<ul>
<li>The deadline to apply for Singapore International Pre Graduate Award is <strong>31 July 2025</strong>.</li>

<li>Make sure to apply before the SIPGA Scholarship deadline for attachments starting in January-April 2026.</li>
